scripts.build: pnpm --filter @conduit/updates build && pnpm --dir ../.. core:build && pnpm electron:native:build && pnpm --dir ../.. --filter @conduit/web build && pnpm electron:main:build
scripts.check: pnpm electron:main:build && pnpm --filter @conduit/updates build && if ! pkg-config --exists mpv 2>/dev/null; then echo 'Skipping desktop check (pkg-config mpv not found)'; else cargo check -p conduit-electron-native; fi
scripts.dev: pnpm electron:native:build && pnpm electron:main:build && node electron/run.mjs .
scripts.electron:build: pnpm electron:native:build && pnpm --dir ../.. --filter @conduit/web build && pnpm electron:main:build
scripts.electron:dev: pnpm electron:native:build && pnpm electron:main:build && node electron/run.mjs .
scripts.dist: pnpm build && pnpm electron:native:build:release && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:win: pnpm build && pnpm electron:native:build:release && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: pnpm build && pnpm electron:native:build:release && electron-builder --linux --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm build && pnpm electron:native:build:release && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:win:arm64: pnpm build && pnpm electron:native:build:release && electron-builder --win --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: pnpm build && pnpm electron:native:build:release && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:x64: pnpm build && pnpm electron:native:build:release && electron-builder --mac --x64 --publish never
